label: DRV8830 Motor Ramp Demo
info: A battery-powered motor controller. An Inject node ticks once per second into a Function node that ramps msg.payload.voltage from 0 to 3.0 V in 0.5 V steps, holds 3.0 V for 5 s, then reverses to -3.0 V — the DRV8830 regulates that average voltage across the motor, so speed stays constant while the battery sags. A second, independent Inject node polls every 2 s (any message) so the periph-drv8830 node emits its fault status; a Function node checks msg.payload.fault and, if set, sends {stop: true} followed by {clear_fault: true} back into the driver to recover, while a Debug node shows every status reading.
